feature: Opt-in approved public HTTP(S) document GET, bounded text/HTML extraction and conversation-local paged snapshots
digest_method: SHA256 of compact ASCII JSON arrays [POSIX relative path, SHA256 of CRLF-normalized-to-LF bytes], sorted by path, immediate *.py files per directory

source_reference.scope: Read pinned URL/permission, MIME, bounded response, HTML text extraction and timeout code. Upstream has special User-Agent retry; Sprig does not copy retries or persistent authorization. No upstream tests/runtime comparison.

development_corrections: A new regression reproduced a 5169-byte redirect diagnostic exceeding max_output=1024. The fix omits the full target with redirect_url_omitted instead of truncating it; the regression and all sealed suites are after this fix. Earlier full/scoped passes are not final-source evidence.
Initial optional request_timeout=None used min directly; aligned web fallback with the existing provider timeout before final freeze.
Fixture SessionStore now closes with contextlib.closing, profile fixture supplies a model, and confirmed new-conversation UI is awaited; no production approval or privacy rule relaxed.
Shipped schema regenerated and the explicit known-tool contract includes the new optional tool. Default model tool schema count remains unchanged. All final suites are after these corrections.

remote_ci.shared_transport_change: Add an overridable address-resolution method; existing provider/MCP transport still uses ordinary resolution. Only web adds address vetting.
remote_ci.after_freeze: Verify account restriction and prior exact-SHA gate before next CI-enabled batch.

limits: Web text retrieval is not search, a browser, JavaScript/CSS rendering, login, arbitrary upload or binary/PDF transport.
Direct public connections only; no proxy/auth/cookie inheritance, automatic redirects, retry, challenge bypass or installs. GET may have remote effects.
Conservative public-address policy excludes special-use ranges consistently across Python versions. Synchronous system DNS cannot be forcibly interrupted; late results are rejected before connect.
Snapshots are memory-only and evictable; displayed model tool pages may be saved as ordinary private conversation history. Private storage is not encrypted.
Known credentials and common secret query names are blocked, not every conceivable custom signed parameter. Users must review the full approved URL.
HTML conversion is a bounded extraction, not a guarantee of visual/semantic completeness. All page content remains untrusted and cannot approve local actions.
Public-address restrictions are not an OS sandbox and do not constrain independently approved run/MCP operations.
Platform skips are not passes; local Windows/WSL do not replace native CI runners, full Python/client/macOS matrix remains pending.
No external model calls or extra paid account. Fixed replies and protocol checks do not establish new coding performance or parity with top agents.
